author: ItsIcyB
body: I was playing Avicus today as I normally do and out of the blue I was banned for Hacking - Fly, Bow Aimbot. This is a mistake because I wasn't hacking, I don't know why this happened but I would like this fixed as Avicus is one of my favourite servers to play. I was banned by FriendlyModOscar at 4:35:25 GMT. Thank you

replies.author: ItsIcyB
replies.body: I'm sorry I still don't see? I was on a bridge under the map and I see no evidence for Bow Aimbot anywhere in that video? I have built up a reputation over the years that I have been playing and I don't want to be remembered as a lowlife hacker. Sure I've been accused but that's what happens when people lose sadly. I would love to play again but I'm not coming on my alternate account with the fear of that being banned (Since it's name is similar to my main account) and never playing again. Like I've said before, Avicus is my favourite servers to play and I am one of the veterans who played in the early stages so I'd love to see this resolved.
